APP_NAME.about: The app's store name (decision #12 placeholder name; the owner chooses the final one). No "Google" in it.

DEVELOPER_NAME.about: The person or company that publishes the app, as shown on the store listings. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

DEVELOPER_ADDRESS.about: The publisher's postal address for legal notices and the stores' developer details. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

SUPPORT_EMAIL.about: The support address: feedback mail goes here, and the store listings and legal pages show it. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

SUPPORT_URL.about: The support web page (App Store 'Support URL'; Play 'Website').

PRIVACY_POLICY_URL.about: Where docs/release/legal/privacy-policy.md is hosted. Placeholder until the owner hosts it; the release check refuses it.

TERMS_URL.about: Where docs/release/legal/terms.md is hosted. Placeholder until the owner hosts it; the release check refuses it.

EFFECTIVE_DATE.about: The date the hosted privacy policy and terms take effect, for example 1 January 2027. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

ANALYTICS_RETENTION.about: The Firebase Analytics data retention chosen in the console (Admin > Data retention), for example 14 months. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

GOVERNING_LAW.about: The country or state whose law governs the terms, for example Malaysia. Set by the owner on 2026-11-12.

DEMO_VIDEO_URL.about: The unlisted video for App Review showing discovery, pairing and control on a real TV.

ADMOB_PUBLISHER_ID.about: The AdMob publisher id (pub-0000000000000000 form) for app-ads.txt.

APP_STORE_ID.about: The numeric Apple id from App Store Connect, used in the App Store link. Placeholder until the App Store record exists; the release check refuses it.

PLAY_PACKAGE.about: The prod Android application id (app/lib/app/flavor.dart); fixed once the app is on Play.
